venue: Schottenstein Center (Value City Arena), Columbus, OH
context: Clash in Italy go-home show (May 31, Turin). Noche de Los Grandes in 5 days (May 30, Monterrey). Go-home show calibrated as CONTAINMENT — four clean/near-clean finishes, no title changes, all storylines advanced through positioning rather than irreversible in-ring action. Two contract signings (Oba/Brock opening, Roman/Fatu closing) formalized the remaining Italy marquee matches. Theory rampage (3 chair attacks, suspended) CREATED the Seth/Profits alliance Vision was trying to prevent. Logan Paul out (torn triceps) — Bron replaces him as Theory's tag partner. Babyface coalition exclusivity partially broke: Ford agreed to team with Seth after competitive test (Stomp) + external crisis (Dawkins chair attack). King of the Ring / Queen of the Ring announced for next week.

segments.outcome: Heyman hypes Lesnar/Femi Italy rematch. Lesnar video package: 'that win will cost him more than he can imagine,' vows to 'rule over Oba Femi.' Femi responds in-arena: 'This time he's fighting to kill him.' Both signed the contract for Italy rematch.
segments.notes: Lesnar's 'rule over' language is sovereignty-register, not competition. Femi's 'kill' escalation matches double-forging thesis: WM42 was credential #1, Italy is credential #3. Video-package structure keeps Brock off-site physically while maximizing presence.

segments.outcome: Logan Paul torn triceps — out for months. Heyman informed Theory that Bron Breakker replaces Paul as Theory's tag partner in Vision.
segments.notes: Celebrity-class operative removed by injury. Monster-class operative (Bron) elevated to permanent tag position. Vision reshuffles: Heyman -> Bron/Theory (active), Logan (shelved). Faction becomes pure wrestling-operative unit — Logan was social-media reach arm.

segments.outcome: Theory attacked Hendry from behind with steel chair backstage. Multiple strikes to the face. Hendry wasn't involved in Logan's injury.
segments.notes: First of THREE Theory chair attacks tonight. Misdirected rage — punishing people who didn't cause the problem. Operative-class soldier unhinged by faction restructure.

segments.outcome: Rollins proposed alliance against Vision. Ford countered: wrestle me first, then we'll talk. Dawkins hesitant.
segments.notes: Bound-Loki isolation arc continues. Ford demands competitive test before granting partnership — won't give it for free. The Profits' fracture-seed (5/18: Ford's head-shake) is now Ford's CONDITION.

segments.outcome: Penta (c) def. Je'Von Evans via Mexican Destroyer (pinfall). IC Championship retained. Evans rejected Penta's hand-raise post-match — pulled away angrily.
segments.notes: Third consecutive IC defense for Penta (Page at SNME, now Evans). Evans' rejection of sportsmanship gesture = generational-succession register turning bitter. Different from Sol's boredom (dismissive) — Evans' anger is aspirational-frustrated.

segments.outcome: Evans apologized for losing composure. Penta praised Evans. Rey Mysterio appeared — congratulated Penta, requested IC Championship match to 'cement his legacy.'
segments.notes: Legend requesting — not demanding — the title shot. Rey as AAA GM asking for WWE title shot = cross-institutional intersection.

segments.outcome: Raw LIVE from Italy announced for next week (2/1c on Netflix). Rey narrated El Grande Americano video promoting Noche de Los Grandes. King of the Ring / Queen of the Ring tournaments announced to begin next week.
segments.notes: Three-continent weekend density confirmed and expanding. Italy Raw (Mon) -> Monterrey NdlG (Sat) -> Turin Clash (Sun). KOTR = fresh tournament structure layering long-term program seeds inside short-term PLE go-home cycle.

segments.outcome: LA Knight announced King of the Ring entry for World Championship path. Criticized Bloodline's treatment of Jacob Fatu. Jimmy Uso interrupted — defended Bloodline as 'family business,' warned Knight. Knight: 'If the family business becomes his business, he'll put them out of business.'
segments.notes: Escalation from 'NOT NOW' register (5/18 Usos deflecting Knight) to active confrontation. Jimmy drawing explicit line — defensive exclusion mode now threatening. Knight positions OUTSIDE family system entirely — not litigating within it (Jacob's register) but threatening to shut it down from outside. Two different challenges to Roman's sovereignty.

segments.outcome: Pearce and Rey discussed Penta vs Rey IC title match. Page interrupted demanding rematch (lost to Penta at SNME). Pearce rejected Page's claim. Rey vs Rusev booked as IC #1 contender qualifier.
segments.notes: Institution closing the door on the failed challenger. Rey earning shot through competition rather than decree despite institutional position (AAA GM).

segments.outcome: Bayley & Lyra Valkyria def. Raquel Rodriguez & Roxanne Perez via roll-up (Bayley on Perez). Liv Morgan ejected from ringside before finish. Dom distracted referee with AAA Mega Championship; Roxanne accidentally struck Dom with the belt. Bayley capitalized.
segments.notes: JD women's-primary-faction reading gets its first in-ring test — and the male holdout (Dom, Dumuzi figure) whose interference BACKFIRES causes the loss. AAA Championship used as prop that causes defeat = cross-institutional object becoming liability inside WWE's ring. Dom's Inanna-substitute-payment timeline advances: consort's attempt to help CAUSED the defeat. The myth's machinery operating in plain sight.

segments.outcome: Seth Rollins def. Montez Ford via Stomp (pinfall). Competitive throughout — superplex into Falcon Arrow near-fall, multiple reversed Pedigree attempts. During/post-match: Theory attacked Angelo Dawkins with steel chair on stage (2nd chair attack of night). Dawkins checked by medical.
segments.notes: Ford's competitive condition HONORED — Rollins earned partnership in the ring, not through persuasion. Theory's attack on Dawkins during the match is the catalyst that transforms partnership-by-challenge into partnership-by-crisis. Vision operative's misdirected rage creates the very alliance he should be preventing.

segments.outcome: Ford and Rollins agreed to work together against Vision after Dawkins' attack. Rollins demanded Bron Breakker as his next opponent.
segments.notes: Bound-Loki's isolation BROKE — but through external violence, not his own diplomacy. Ragnarok-army-forming advances: Dawkins first recruit (5/18), now Ford joins via Theory's provocation. Alliance formed from competitive respect + shared crisis.

segments.outcome: Adam Pearce suspended Austin Theory for the chair attacks. Heyman told Theory that Pearce is incompetent — escorted Theory away. Theory shown interacting with Maxxine Dupri (romantic interest). Otis expressed concern ('smells like bad news').
segments.notes: Operative removed from faction's active roster by institutional authority. Heyman comforts, not disciplines = architect protects soldier from institution even when soldier's behavior is counterproductive. Maxxine Dupri angle seeds potential Vision exit — Alpha Academy-adjacent romantic pull = classic defection setup.

segments.outcome: Becky interview: 'Sol got punched in the face and realizes she's in over her head now.' Challenged Sol to prove herself in Italy. 'My accomplishments are written in stone, hers are written in sand.'
segments.notes: Veteran-hedging register continues from 5/18 through SNME (DQ escape). 'Stone vs sand' = Becky reframing generational-succession as legacy vs moment. After SNME DQ, institution booked Italy title match anyway (Aldis closed escape hatch). Becky's only play left is verbal frame war.

segments.outcome: Rey Mysterio def. Rusev via roll-up (school boy reversal of Accolade submission). IC #1 contender qualifier. Lionsault near-fall. Post-match: Rusev attacked Rey. Dragon Lee made the save — hit a dive. Rey followed with 619 on both Rusev and Page (who ran in). Page on commentary throughout.
segments.notes: Rey earns #1 contender spot the hard way — surviving the submission and reversing it. Veteran ring IQ over power wrestler's brute force. Dragon Lee as Rey's ally = lucha-lineage unit (two generations of masked tecnico tradition). Page eating 619 post-match keeps him in IC orbit even after institutional rejection.

segments.outcome: Pearce informed Reigns that Fatu shouldn't be employed. Reigns countered: as Tribal Chief, must maintain authority. Pearce negotiated contract terms: loser serves winner.
segments.notes: Institution and patriarch negotiating the terms of the family's sacred match. Pearce's role reduced to paperwork — the family's jurisdiction (claimed 5/18) now runs through the institution as formality, not authority.

segments.outcome: Tribal Combat contract signed for Clash in Italy. Fatu signed first, threw furniture at security. 'Happy Birthday' chants for Roman (turning 41). Stipulation formalized: loser serves winner as servant. Fatu: 'I will dog walk his ass.' Roman: 'I will domesticate Fatu and make him love his Tribal Chief.' Both performed Tribal Combat handshake. Final image: heads pressed together.
segments.notes: Sovereignty litigation formalized. Stipulation is FEUDAL (loser serves), not competitive. Fatu's Backlash grievance (exposed turnbuckle) = legal brief; Roman's 'domesticate' language deliberately dehumanizing — Transformed King's private confession (5/18 'I have to') and public performance diverging further. Heads-pressed-together close = Samoan hongi (forehead press, sharing breath/life-force). Even in enmity the family ritual holds. Two men who MUST fight under family code performing family's greeting — that image IS the arc. Birthday chants add biographical texture.
